newsitem.title: USA: Cross-Continent Auto to buy Chaisson.
newsitem.headline: Cross-Continent Auto to buy Chaisson.

text.p: Cross-Continent Auto Retailers Inc said Thursday it had reached a definitive agreement to buy Chaisson Motor Cars for $27.5 million in cash, stock and promissory notes.
The company said Chaisson, a multiple franchise dealership group in Las Vegas that sells luxury cars, had sales of $70 million in 1996.
The deal, for which it will account as an asset purchase, is the fourth major acquisition since its initial public offering on September 23, 1996, it said.
Once it completes the deal and other pending acquisitions, the company will own and operate a group of 13 franchised automobile dealerships in Texas, Oklahoma, Nevada and Colorado, it added.
Cross-Continent sells new and used cars and light trucks, among other services.
